name: Unidentified planet
description: A terrestrial planet was the site of a cave with a deposit of space crystals. At one point, the protocol droid C-3PO and the astromech droid R2-D2 visited the planet while traveling on a single-pilot starship. After obtaining space crystals from the cave, the droids traveled to Tatooine.
